_about: Game systems the mashup adds or changes, one row each. Creator's design (2026-11-09): the Pale Knight fires; transforming is Lies of P's Pale Knight buff, which raises its shot damage; built on the Holy Moonlight Sword's moveset (a143), whose transformed attacks already fire a projectile. Cataclysm: hold to charge, Lies of P animations, and it takes the place of the Hunter's left arm. 'status' = designed / built / verified (seen working in the running game).

rows.what: Moveset slots, hit windows, cancels and the projectile events come from the Holy Moonlight Sword
rows.bbMechanism: TAE category a160 copied from a143; EquipParamWeapon row copied from 26000000 (wepmotionCategory 143, behaviorVariationId 2600)
rows.values: wepmotionCategory=143 kept so the Hunter uses the copied a160 TAE through wepmotionBothHandId=60

rows.what: The Pale Knight fires a shot from its barrel on its gun attacks (transformed R2, charged R2 and transformed L1)
rows.bbMechanism: the HMS slots' bullet events keep firing, through the Pale Knight's own BehaviorParam_PC rows (copied from behaviorVariationId 2600) pointing at a new Bullet row: a fast short-range explosive shot copied from the Hunter Blunderbuss/Cannon bullet with the moonlight visuals swapped for gunfire
rows.lopSource: montage marks LProjectile / LChargeShotgunFired give the fire time

rows.what: Transforming plays Lies of P's Pale Knight fable-art buff and raises the shot's damage for a while
rows.bbMechanism: transform slots (33300 / 43300) play the converted MT_Fable_GunBlade_BLD and apply a new SpEffect (copied from a weapon-buff SpEffect) that multiplies the shot's damage; the blade glows while it lasts

rows.what: Every Pale Knight move uses the converted Lies of P animation
rows.bbMechanism: new a160_xxxxxx.hkx in c0000_a9x.anibnd, built from the player's Lies of P at setup; TAE slots point at them, events re-timed to the Lies of P marks

rows.what: Hold to charge, release for the big blast
rows.bbMechanism: left-hand gun slots: tap fire 51000, hold-charge then release 52550 (the Cannon/Blunderbuss charge flow), charged blast uses a stronger Bullet row

rows.what: Equipped, it is the Hunter's left arm: the whole Lies of P forearm, hand and cannon, over the Hunter's own forearm
rows.bbMechanism: weapon model built in the left-hand weapon's space so it covers forearm and hand (fit 'arm-cover'); the Hunter's sleeve stays inside it

rows.what: L1 while standing or moving transforms the Pale Knight with the Lies of P twirl (creator 2026-11-10, 0.3.2 test: it only transformed from a combo)
rows.bbMechanism: control script (text HKS), Act_AttackRight's plain-transform branch: when the right weapon's own moveset is 160 and it is in its normal form, fire W_ChangeGimmick_RightSide_ModeA (the combo transform, slot 33310 = converted Lies of P twirl + Strengthen Bullet, proven to transform) instead of W_ChangeGimmick (the shared Moonlight Sword idle transform). Transforming back from standing keeps Bloodborne's own shared move (a000_019570), which is known to work.

rows.what: Cataclysm stays along the forearm as in Lies of P instead of being twisted forward like a pistol when idle/walking
rows.bbMechanism: control script: after Act_LeftWeaponAddAnime runs, MasterBlend = 0 for left moveset 161 (switches off the pistol-holding additive layer); LeftWeaponAdd itself is left as the pistol's, so the firing moves still find their clips (0.2.9: LeftWeaponAdd 100 locked firing in an A-pose)

rows.what: Cataclysm's fire, charge and dash-fire use the converted Lies of P animations
rows.bbMechanism: new a161_xxxxxx.hkx, upper-body only so the legs keep Bloodborne's movement

rows.what: Creator 2026-11-18: dodging left or right (locked on) and firing the Cataclysm plays Lies of P's own left/right Legion-arm dash instead of the back-dash fire every direction used
rows.bbMechanism: Bloodborne picks a left-gun roll shot through manual selectors named 'AtkLeft_GunShot_Rolling_IdleNN Front/Back/Left/Right' (all four ask for slot 52550 family, NoLock 52250). The Left and Right selectors are given their own slot families (52750 / 52850, same +2/+3/+5 and +10 buffed offsets) for every gun moveset they hold (their clips cloned and renamed to the new slot); every other gun's new slot imports its own 52550-family move (TAE ImportOtherAnim), so other guns play exactly what they did; the Cataclysm's new slots are new moves rows (newSlot) with the Lies of P dash.
rows.values: moves rows 52750 (left), 52850 (right); shot at 0.25 s into the dash (hitTime)

rows.what: Creator 2026-11-18 (0.3.34 test): the held R2 fires no pellets in either form (they flew backwards); its spin slash deals physical, fire and arcane damage
rows.bbMechanism: 32630: no added shot or gun flash; 42630: template shot stripped (stripShots). Slash judges 170/570/571 get own AtkParam copies 9608000+judge with phys/arcane(mag)/fire corrections equal (shots mixedDamage).

rows.what: Creator 2026-11-18: the Boom Hammer's transformed-R1 fire burns on the Pale Knight's blade during the held R2's spin slash
rows.bbMechanism: moves trailFxFrom a145:40000: the Boom Hammer transformed R1's effect events (type 96: fire 7115 on its head points, burst 267) and its swing sounds (type 128, kind 1) around its hit, moved onto the held R2's spin-slash hit (same lead time) and onto the blade points trailFxPoints, ending trailFxTail after the slash's hit
